topic: One original luxury hotel hot dog, same Wagyu sausage, toasted brioche bun, chef hands, copper pan, and warm kitchen throughout. Six moving actions in order: sausage touches hot pan; truffle cream spread inside toasted bun; same sausage turns to reveal crust in pan; sausage lifted into bun; one small caviar spoon added; guest takes one visible bite from that same hot dog. No gold leaf, no price claim, no extra dishes.
style: photoreal cinematic food film, warm tungsten hotel kitchen, close macro detail, shallow depth of field, rich natural texture
requestedEnding: A guest takes one clear bite of the finished Wagyu hot dog and reveals the crisp bun and juicy sausage.

storyArc.goal: To create a perfectly executed luxury hotel hot dog, culminating in a satisfying bite for the guest.
storyArc.obstacle: Achieving the perfect crust on the sausage without drying it out.
storyArc.turn: The chef expertly turns the sausage, allowing even heat distribution and creating a beautiful, crispy crust.
storyArc.visualBible: Close-up macro photography, shallow depth of field, rich natural textures, warm tungsten lighting. Focus on the chef's hands and the transformation of the sausage. No gold leaf, no price claims, no extra dishes. The bun must be toasted, not burnt. Truffle cream must be visibly spread.
